example:
import { EditorialBreadcrumb, EditorialSection } from "@godxjp/ui/layout";

<EditorialSection>
  <EditorialBreadcrumb items={[{ label: "Home", to: "/" }, { label: "Journal", to: "/journal/" }, { label: "Price guide" }]} />
</EditorialSection>
name: EditorialBreadcrumb

props.description: Trail, root first; the last item is the current page.
props.name: items

tagline: The trail at the top of an editorial page (gh#1437): `Breadcrumb` (same `<nav>`/`<ol>`, `aria-current` on the last item, router `linkComponent`) with the editorial rhythm — top inset, gap and line height from `--editorial-breadcrumb-*`. Use it alone above a reader page; `EditorialPageHeader` renders it for a listing page.
usage: DO put it first in an EditorialSection of a `flow="sections"` page.
DON'T nest it in a PageContainer — that page shell has its own trail.
